title: GitHub label set
description: Machine-readable statement of the labels every repository this account owns must carry. config/github/labels.json is the only place the set is written down; scripts/github-labels.sh renders it (plus one agent:<platform> label per platform in the capability registry) and diffs it against the live API, and scripts/check-github-labels.sh holds the file to this schema offline. Every object closes with additionalProperties:false so a misspelled key is an error, not an ignored field.

version.description: Content version of the label set. Bumped on every change, per the _contract canonical-config pattern.

agent_labels.description: How the per-platform agent:<platform> labels are rendered. The platform list is never written here: it is read from the capability registry at apply time, so a platform added to the registry gets its label on the next apply without a change to the label set.

prefix.description: Pinned: switch-dev, update-issue-resume.sh and the agent_task issue template all match labels on this prefix.

registry.description: Repo-relative path of the capability registry whose platforms keys become label suffixes.

description_template.description: Rendered once per platform with {display_name} replaced by the registry's display_name.

color.description: Six lowercase hex digits, no leading #, exactly as the REST API returns it. Lowercase so the file and the live value compare byte for byte.

name.description: GitHub's limit is 50 characters; names are unique per repository case-insensitively.

description.description: GitHub truncates at 100 characters; the comparison would never converge on a longer value.

origin.description: github-default: one of the nine labels GitHub creates on a new repository, listed so a repository that lost it is repaired. tamirs: added by this account and owed a _comment naming who depends on it (checked by scripts/check-github-labels.sh).
